summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Wahed FTSE USA Shariah ETF (HLAL) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the FTSE USA Shariah index, a principles-selected, market-cap-weighted index of US equities. HLAL was launched on Jul 16, 2019 and is issued by Wahed.

holdings.infoBox: HLAL is an equity ETF with a total of 201 individual holdings. The top holdings are NVIDIA stock at 13.32%, Apple at 12.12%, Microsoft at 9.44%, Alphabet at 9.00%, and Broadcom at 4.06%.
